name: bookmark_search
description: Parse and search Firefox bookmark export files (Netscape HTML format). Supports keyword and quoted phrase search, plus filters by tags, folder path fragments, and domains. Actions: search, list_tags, list_folders, stats.

file_path.description: Bookmark HTML file path. Default: data/bookmarks.html

query.description: Search query. Supports quoted phrases, e.g. "food license" oregon

tags.description: Tag filter(s), comma-separated string or array. Matches Firefox TAGS and folder-derived labels.

folders.description: Folder path fragment filter(s), comma-separated string or array.

domains.description: Domain filter(s), comma-separated string or array (e.g., github.com, reddit.com).

query_mode.description: How to match terms/filters: any (default) or all.

sort_by.description: Sort order for search results. Default: relevance.

include_duplicates.description: Include duplicate URLs in results. Default: true.
